name: AWS ECS Cluster
documentation: Amazon Elastic Container Service cluster named 'demo-system-cluster' provisioned in the us-east-1 region. Acts as the primary container orchestration execution environment that hosts all containerized application services for the demo system. Defined as an aws_ecs_cluster Terraform resource.

evidence.locator: /evidence/demo-system/interviews/cto_interview.txt :: CTO statement on AWS ECS Cluster (Node)

name: AWS RDS Node
documentation: Amazon Relational Database Service managed node hosting the Postgres 15.3 database engine. Provisioned as a db.t3.micro instance class with 20 GB allocated storage and database name 'demodb'. Provides the managed relational database runtime environment for transactional payment data persistence.

evidence.locator: /evidence/demo-system/interviews/cto_interview.txt :: CTO statement on AWS RDS Node

name: AWS ElastiCache Redis Node
documentation: Amazon ElastiCache cluster named 'demo-redis' running the Redis 7 engine on a cache.t3.micro node type with a single cache node. Uses the 'default.redis7' parameter group. Serves as an in-memory caching execution environment supporting the application layer with fast data retrieval and session management.

name: Postgres DB Engine
documentation: PostgreSQL version 15.3 database management system running on the AWS RDS Node. Acts as the runtime system software providing relational database capabilities including query processing, transaction management, and ACID compliance. The Payment DB Artifact (schema) is assigned to this engine for execution.

evidence.locator: /evidence/demo-system/docs/architecture.md :: Technology Layer / Postgres DB Engine (System Software)
/evidence/demo-system/interviews/cto_interview.txt :: CTO statement on Postgres DB Engine (System Software)

name: Redis Cache Engine
documentation: Redis 7 in-memory data structure store running within the AWS ElastiCache cluster. Provides caching, session storage, and high-speed key-value operations as system software. Configured via the 'default.redis7' parameter group on a single cache node.

name: Payment DB Artifact
documentation: Deployed database schema artifact representing the physical database schema deployment assigned to the Postgres DB Engine on the AWS RDS Node. Contains the transactional payment data structures (tables, indexes, constraints) used by the Payment Processing Service to persist payment records.

evidence.locator: /evidence/demo-system/interviews/cto_interview.txt :: CTO statement on Payment DB Artifact assigned to Postgres DB Engine

name: AWS ECS Technology Service
documentation: Container orchestration technology service exposed by the AWS ECS Cluster Node. Provides managed container scheduling, service discovery, load balancing, and auto-scaling capabilities to application components. Realized by the AWS ECS Cluster Node and serves the Payment Processing Application Service layer.

evidence.locator: /evidence/demo-system/docs/architecture.md :: Technology Layer / AWS ECS Technology Service (Technology Service)
/evidence/demo-system/interviews/cto_interview.txt :: CTO statement on AWS ECS Technology Service realized by ECS Cluster

name: AWS RDS Technology Service
documentation: Managed relational database technology service exposed by the AWS RDS Node. Provides automated backups, patching, high availability, monitoring, and database connectivity as a managed infrastructure service. Realized by the AWS RDS Node and consumed by application components requiring persistent relational data storage.

evidence.locator: /evidence/demo-system/docs/architecture.md :: Technology Layer / AWS RDS Technology Service (Technology Service)
/evidence/demo-system/interviews/cto_interview.txt :: CTO statement on AWS RDS Technology Service realized by AWS RDS Node
